feed.title: NFSU Delhi — MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application closes
feed.body: Same program, Delhi campus, same CUET-PG-based selection, 22 seats. Apply to both NFSU campuses off the one Samarth portal, two more shots for the same effort.

feed.title: NFSU Gandhinagar — MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application closes
feed.body: Selection is on your CUET-PG 2026 score, not a separate NFSU test. 24 seats. Apply off the Samarth portal. Eligibility: 4-yr BA/BSc Psych, or 3-yr + bridge, min 55%.

feed.title: Focus narrowed to five — NIMHANS + Manipal off the board
feed.body: Everything now points at five live targets: Amity Noida, SGT, RML, IHBAS and CIP (Ranchi). NIMHANS and Manipal/MET are done for this cycle (both sat, both closed), so they've been pulled off the tracker, the dashboard and this feed so they're not in your face. SGT and CIP start building out the moment you send a syllabus, pattern or papers.

feed.title: RML / ABVIMS — MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application closes
feed.body: Closes first of everything live. Runs on the GGSIPU portal, admission is the CET-166 entrance (not your MET). 70% test + 30% interview, app fee Rs 2,500. Deadline was extended from 30 May to 7 June, so it is genuinely open. Do this one today.

feed.title: RCI Admissions Tracker rebuilt — DIMHANS Dharwad added
feed.body: Full RCI Clinical Psych tracker re-checked against the institute portals. Added DIMHANS Dharwad (RCI, own psychiatric hospital for in-house clinical hours). Two gates on it: Karnataka domicile is mandatory and the M.Phil track is only a handful of seats. Cycle historically opens ~Sep–Oct.

feed.title: RML / ABVIMS deadline extended to 7 June
feed.body: ABVIMS / Dr RML Hospital pushed its MA Clinical Psychology (RCI) application deadline from 30 May to 7 June 2026 on the GGSIPU portal. That makes it your earliest live window, so it goes first.

feed.title: Christ University is CLOSED (the 'June 14' was wrong)
feed.body: Earlier note said Christ Delhi NCR was open until 14 June. That is wrong: Christ's RCI MA Clinical Psych closed 2 February 2026 with the entrance in February. Don't chase it for this cycle. If you see a 'Delhi NCR June' date anywhere it's a different non-RCI stream, check the RCI tag first.

feed.title: NFSU Gandhinagar + Delhi windows open (due 10 June)
feed.body: Both NFSU RCI MA Clinical Psych campuses are taking applications, due 10 June, selected on CUET-PG score. This corrects the earlier 'NFSU own entrance' line, there's no separate NFSU test.

feed.title: M.Phil Clinical Psychology replaced by the RCI MA
feed.body: From 2026, under NEP 2020 + RCI restructuring, the old M.Phil Clinical Psychology is being replaced by the MA Clinical Psychology (RCI). So the RCI-tagged MA at IHBAS / CIP / RML / Amity (where tagged) IS the licensing program now, not a lesser step. A plain MA/MSc with no RCI tag does not license you. The only thing that matters is the RCI tag.

feed.title: 2027 cycle — the heavy hitters reopen Dec 2026–Feb 2027
feed.body: IHBAS, CIP Ranchi and RINPAS typically open applications between December 2026 and February 2027, entrances around April–May. If this cycle doesn't land, that's your real runway for the top RCI seats. This board will flag each one the day it opens.
